title: Gene
description: A reusable behavioral pattern extracted from game-development AI agent trajectories. Genes represent recurring strategies, diagnostic patterns, and workflow rhythms that can be matched to new user prompts for improved agent behavior.

category.description: workflow=implementation pattern, diagnostic=bug/error investigation, session_rhythm=cross-turn cadence, operational=meta/build, informational=read-only

signals_match.description: Tags and conditions that trigger this gene. Format: 'dimension:value' or bare keyword.

preconditions.description: Natural language conditions (Chinese) that must be true for this gene to activate.

strategy.description: Ordered action steps (Chinese) the agent should follow when this gene is matched.

validation.description: Verification checks to confirm the gene's strategy was correctly applied.
